title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Black Grape
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Black Grape Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This juicy fruit refill includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a dark grape flavour profile. Black Grape delivers a rich, full-bodied burst of juicy Grape flavour with just a touch of tang for balance. Smooth and fruity with a gently tart edge, it’s a great option for vapers who enjoy lush, authentic fruit flavours. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
